contentText: On the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women, FRANCE 24's François Picard is pleased to welcome back Choralyne Dumesnil, an attorney practising in Paris and California, to discuss misogyny, sexual violence, cyberbullying and the challenges victims face in seeking justice. "There's always that stigma when you lodge a complaint. You get questioned, you get cross-examined," notes Picard. Despite efforts to raise awareness, Dumesnil sees little significant change in society.
